reply_text:
*I’d hold the merge for two issues* in `main...coupon-checkout` (head `a68c0e7`).

1. *[P1] Tax is calculated before the coupon — `src/total.js:6`*
   `tax(subtotal, taxPercent)` taxes the original subtotal, contrary to the README’s discounted-subtotal rule.
   • Repro: subtotal `10000`, coupon `20%`, tax `10%`, shipping `500`.
   • Actual: `9500` cents. Expected: `9300` cents.
   • A 100% coupon still leaves tax owing.
   Calculate tax on `subtotal - discount`.

2. *[P2] Checkout bypasses coupon bounds — `src/total.js:5`*
   It uses `pct` rather than the new `couponValue` helper, so its 0–100% clamp never applies.
   • Subtotal `10000`, coupon `150%`, no tax/shipping → total `-5000`.
   • Coupon `-10%` → total `11000`, effectively adding a surcharge.
   Use `couponValue` so checkout respects the coupon bounds.

*Validation:* All four existing tests pass, but neither checkout test uses a nonzero coupon. Add regression coverage for coupon-plus-tax, 100% coupons, and out-of-range percentages.

No files changed.
